topic: An evening at the book fair
passage: Last Friday evening, I visited the book fair in the city center. My friend and I walked around the big hall and looked at thousands of books. The lights looked warm, and the shelves reached the ceiling. We stopped at a stall of old books. I picked up a book about Chinese calligraphy and read a few pages. The owner, an old man, smiled and asked about my interest. He showed me a brush pen and wrote my name in beautiful characters. I watched him carefully and asked many questions. He answered each one with patience. At last, I picked out three books and paid sixty yuan. On the way home, my friend and I stopped for noodles. We talked about our favorite books for a long time. I felt happy that night because reading always brings me back to good memories.
